Bommer 170-19-600 Heavy Duty Door Bumper Guard

text.description_html:
Bommer 170-19-600, 19" Heavy Duty Bumper Guard

Packaged complete with one (1) 19" x 8" Bumper Guard, one (1) Back Plate, one (1) Mounting Plate plus six (6) 5/16-18 thrubolts and nuts (bolt length for standard for 1-3/4" thick door).

The door Bumper Guard is heavy duty .125" thick spring steel (ANSI K87434). The included back plate protects the face of the door from wear caused by sliding motion of the Bumper Guard.

Used to protect commercial doors such as warehouses and factory doors that are run into with carts and forklifts. Also used on hospitals doors to protect against gurneys (gurney door guards). For use on wood and metal doors.

Can be install on one side of a single acting door or back to back on double acting doors (door swings in both directions). Note: Back to back installation requires Two (2) Bumpers.




***This item is Discontinued, please see Available Stainless Steel Bumper Guards
19 x 8 Stainless Steel Bumper Guard
32 x 8 Stainless Steel Bumper Guard




Specifications for the Bommer 170-19-600 Door Bumper Guard:

  • Material: .125" Spring Steel (Heavy Duty)
  • Finish: Prime Coat
  • Bumper Guard Length: 19"
  • Bumper Guard Height: 8"
  • Bumper Guard Projection: 4"
  • Machine Screws with Nuts: 5/16-18
  • Bommer 170 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Sold Individually.
